tldr: Exact half quotas have a proved eventual minimax precision cost even with the full original record and every estimator: \(\liminf_{n\to\infty,\ n\ \mathrm{even}}n^3g_n(1/2)\ge28-2\sqrt{195}>0\). A faithful endpoint-subclass corollary transfers this bound to Hull's full bounded-outcome class and resolves his all-measurable-estimator strict-suboptimality conjecture for all sufficiently large even populations. This is a one-sided lower bound, not the sharp first nonzero quota-price law. The exact joint full-posterior defect is the proposed route to the still-open all-rational frontier; variance comparisons and separate Airy approximations do not determine that frontier. Finite rational reconstruction yields certified \(\epsilon\)-optimal original-record procedures and \(o(g_n(p))\) errors on already-positive branches. Analytic sharp-frontier attainers and limiting coefficient or arithmetic-set certification remain open.
gap: Unrestricted binary minimax theory identifies nonlinear shrinkage and the Airy gain; complete-randomization comparisons with general estimators remain unresolved beyond restricted analyses and finite examples. Those results leave the first nonzero exact-quota versus expected-quota risk difference undetermined.
fill: The research target evaluates that joint defect for every reduced rational allocation, supplies the first surviving normalization and zero classification, and reconstructs both quota procedures with certified excess risks \(o(g_n(p))\) wherever the price is positive.
